doc: Performance Benchmark Plan v0 mirror - the §73 continuous-measurement metric census, pre-pinned engineering goals, the recorded Fast Path seed with explicit verification state, and the four real-machine follow-up scenarios batched into this plan. Every status cell is bound to an evidence pointer the checker re-resolves against the shipped tree; absent instrumentation is re-derived by independent symbol search, never read from this file.
version_lock: Version lock: this mirror, docs/benchmark-plan.md, scripts/benchplan-check.mjs, internal/discovery/benchplan_check_test.go and docs/schema-v2.md §39 MUST evolve in one PR; the checker re-derives shipped facts (byte accounting symbols, proxy latency accounting, resource-manager and mode symbol absence) from the source tree on every run and fails on any drift - never against this file alone.

status_semantics.PARTIAL: a shipped carrier measures a named slice of this metric; the slice is stated in the row note, the rest stays a declared gap
status_semantics.PLANNED: a future carrier is named by this plan but nothing ships yet; a plan word is never a measurement
status_semantics.ABSENT: no shipped instrument and no same-platform carrier; recorded as a declared gap, and CI may never be presented as this row's verification

axes: This mirror answers 'how is each performance-tax metric instrumented and judged' on the measurement axis. It is NOT the §65 compatibility capability axis and NOT the §279 coverage-truthfulness collection axis; bp.* row ids are machine-checked disjoint from compat.* and coverage row ids.
honesty: Every metric row names at least one evidence pointer resolvable in the shipped tree; an unresolvable pointer fails the checker, so no row can be hollow.
Pre-pinned engineering goals are contract targets, not results: no cell may present an unmeasured goal as a verified achievement, and no external promise may cite them before a real benchmark run.

The recorded fast-path seed is estimation, not verified fact: it carries state 'recorded', a named provenance class, and a re-measure-before-citation requirement; promoting it to a verified claim without a shipped benchmark run fails the gate.

Absent instrumentation is re-derived from the tree (distinctive resource-manager and mode symbols must be zero while the gap rows stay declared); if code ships later, the mirror must be upgraded in the same PR or the drift check fails.
CI three-platform jobs carry a partial shape only: battery, thermal, mode, and real-machine rows prove nothing in CI, and presenting shared-runner numbers as promises is forbidden.
Honest-miss accounting follows the evals known_gap posture: declared, not yet verified, never silently passed.
